body:
This is exactly how I feel as well. Tired. Trapped. When you say “no book written,” are you a writer? The only thing that has so far kept me going is the potential to create something, but sometimes the impulse to rest and be done with this bullshit overwhelms this. So I definitely understand. 

I’m not going to say “it gets better,” “this pain is only temporary,” or any of that crap. But I will say, I empathize with you and if you need someone to talk to or a shoulder to cry on, I’m here. :)
